profiles.name: drum-machine
profiles.text:
# name: drum machine
# publish: yes
# ANALOG 2 for bass, SAMPLE, GRAIN, LOFI, SLICE; every kit, the drum editor, user samples and kits; every FX;
# the icons. Every sample set but STRINGS (it can still be uploaded to a USR slot).
# Off: FM6, DIGITAL, PHASE, VOICE, TRIO, WHEEL.
ENG_DIGITAL=0
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_FM6=0
ENG_SLICE=1
USB_MODE=1
SET_STRGS=0
PATTERNS=1

profiles.name: everything-that-fits
profiles.text:
# name: everything fits
# publish: yes
# Every engine, FM6 option, kit, FX and feature; the CDC console (USB audio is EXPERIMENTAL). Out to fit:
# two sample sets, SCRATCH and STRINGS (they can still be uploaded to a USR slot); the PUNCH ring at 0.37 s
# (pool); the LCD's changed-rectangle strips (RAM code). docs/BUILDER.md lists the trade-offs.
USB_MODE=1
SET_SCRCH=0
SET_STRGS=0
PUNCH_N=16384
LCD_DIRTY=0
# the reverb's lines (17 KB) in the pool, which has room here: main RAM is the scarcer (same sound)
REV_POOL=1
# the CZ engine (Melodee 0.11, engine 13): +7.3 KB flash, +3.2 KB RAM, +32 B RAM code here
ENG_CZ=1
# the knob's help line on the top bar (tools/param_help.json): +6.4 KB flash, no RAM, no RAM code
PARAM_HELP=1

profiles.name: fm-va-studio
profiles.text:
# name: FM + VA studio
# publish: yes
# ANALOG 2, FM6 (every option), DIGITAL, SAMPLE, TRIO; every kit; every sample set but SCRATCH (it can still be

# Off: GRAIN, VOICE, LOFI, PHASE, WHEEL (and the experiments).
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_LOFI=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_GRAIN=0
USB_MODE=1
SET_SCRCH=0

profiles.name: synth
profiles.text:
# name: Synth
# publish: yes
# Optimist Synth: the maintainer's own build, and the default profile (tools/optimist.py, make, the builder's start, the Pages site).
# Taken 2026-10-16 from the maintainer's own configuration (base optimist 25375ac0), plus PARAM_HELP=0, the one item that goes so that every web editor item (ED_*) stays on and the build links.
# Against user-default (the generic reference profile the tests and the emulator gates build): the experimental engines X0X drums, ACID, JUNO, PHYS and NOISE, the DUAL core, BLE, UI=1 (the Optimist UI), USB audio and EQ3 are on; most sample sets, kits and the sampled drums are off.
# firmware builder configuration (tools/builder/registry.py keys; others take their defaults)
# Reserve
RESERVE_UNDO_KB=8
# Synth engines
ENG_SAMPLE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_GRAIN=0
FM6_MODERN=0
FM6_OPL=0
NATIVE_BANKS=1
ENG_PHYS=1
ENG_ACID=1
ENG_NOISE=1
ENG_JUNO=1
UP_FM6=1
# Drums
DRUM_SAMPLED=0
KIT_ACOUSTIC=0
KIT_DEEP=0
KIT_TIGHT=0
KIT_BRIGHT=0
KIT_DUST=0
DRUM_USR=0
DRUM_X0X909=1
X909_CYM=0
DRUM_X0X808=1
# Sample sets
SET_PIANO=0
SET_BASS=0
SET_VIBES=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_SCRCH=0
# FX: any number (each track its own)
FX_SLICER=0
FX_DUST=0
TRK_FILT=1
INS_FOLD=1
INS_FUZZ=1
INS_WIDTH=1
INS_EQ3=1
INS_GATER=1
GLIDE=1
# FX: limited instances (once, or a set count)
DLY_LEN=32768
REV_ROOM=0
REV_FDN8=1
REV_POOL=1
PUNCH_N=16384
INS_CHORUS=2
INS_JCHORUS=2
INS_FLANGER=2
PUNCH_LATCH=1
# Sequencer
CHORDPLUS=1
SNAPSHOTS=8
PATTERNS=1
MACROS=1
ENERGY=1
CHANCE=1
QNT_SEQ=1
MOTION=1
REC_MODES=1
MOTION_MARK=1
SL24_XSTEP=1
MICRO=1
FILLS=1
PLOCK=1
COND=1
SEQTOOLS=1
# MIDI & USB
USB_MODE=2
# UI
UI=1
DIV_ORDER=1
BIGVALS=0
# System
CPU_GUARD=1
SL24_SAFE=0
SL24_IMPORT=0
# Experimental
DUAL=2
BLE=1
BLE_BOND=1
BLE_CENTRAL=1

# every ED_* web editor item stays ON (the default); this is the one thing that goes to make the build link
PARAM_HELP=0
# 2026-10-16 (batch 162): the editor's scope screen is off so the build links (the user's standing approval for the Synth profile)
ED_SCOPE=0

profiles.name: user-default
profiles.text:
# name: user default
# publish: yes
# The integration's default (MIDI only on USB since 2026-10-12: USB audio stays experimental) made to fit with the least loss to the sound
# (the earlier handoff suggestion: LOFI and VOICE out, the delay at 0.74 s), then the SCRATCH sample set
# (23 KB: the SCRATCH preset; the set can still be uploaded to a USR slot).
# With the SLOOP 2.3 fixes on by default (~1.2 KB). The boot logo and FM6's algorithm full screen are back since
# the large font is the small one at scale 2 (-24.7 KB) and SLOOP's dead HOME screen went (2026-10-06).
# 2026-10-08 (the user's builder choice): the VIBES, HORNS and FLUTE sample sets go too (they can still be
# uploaded to a USR slot) and FM6's MODERN and OPL modes; in come FM6 user presets that keep their whole voice
# (UP_FM6), the FM6 / CZ native tone collections in PRESETS (NATIVE_BANKS) and FM6's operator editor in VIEW ALL
# (FM6_ALL back at its default).
# Synth engines
ENG_LOFI=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
FM6_MODERN=0
FM6_OPL=0
NATIVE_BANKS=1
UP_FM6=1
# Sample sets
SET_VIBES=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
SET_SCRCH=0
# FX
DLY_LEN=32768
# the reverb's lines (17 KB) in the pool, which has room here: main RAM is the scarcer (same sound)
REV_POOL=1
# Sequencer
PATTERNS=1
# the automation store (the user, 2026-10-10): held-step pages, chance, nudge, fills and p-locks out of the box
CHANCE=1
MOTION=1
SL24_XSTEP=1
MICRO=1
FILLS=1
PLOCK=1
# Felucca 1.5.6 (2026-10-13): step conditions and STEP's sequence tools (TOOLS, EUCLID)
COND=1
# 2026-10-15 (batch 158, the web editor): SEQTOOLS is OFF in this profile so the Optimist UI build (UI=1) links with the web editor's device commands
# (the profile was over the slot); it stays an item of the builder, and the user's own mots.config keeps its own choice
SEQTOOLS=0
# 2026-10-16 (batch 160, the web editor v14 and the returns' sends): TRIO and WHEEL (drawbar organ) and the editor's oscilloscope command are OFF in this profile so the
# Optimist UI build (UI=1) links; they stay items of the builder, and the user's own mots.config keeps its own choice
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ED_SCOPE=0
# 2026-10-16 (batch 162, LFO 2 always on): the editor's favorites, song-chain and drum-lane mix commands are OFF here so the Optimist UI build (UI=1) links
ED_FAVS=0
ED_SONG=0
ED_DLAN=0

profiles.name: x0x-drums
profiles.text:
# name: x0x drums
# publish: no
# The drum machine with both X0X kits (909 with its ride and crash samples, 808; EXPERIMENTAL). Out to fit
# them: the five sampled kits (ACOUSTIC .. DUST; the 32 synthesised kits stay), the PIANO, HORNS and FLUTE
# sets (STRINGS as in drum-machine; each can still be uploaded to a USR slot), the delay at 0.74 s (pool).
# Synth engines
ENG_DIGITAL=0
ENG_PHASE=0
ENG_FORMANT=0
ENG_TRIO=0
ENG_DRAWBAR=0
ENG_FM6=0
ENG_SLICE=1
# Drums
DRUM_SAMPLED=0
DRUM_X0X909=1
DRUM_X0X808=1
# Sample sets
SET_PIANO=0
SET_HORNS=0
SET_STRGS=0
SET_FLUTE=0
# FX
DLY_LEN=32768
# MIDI & USB
USB_MODE=1
# the reverb's lines (17 KB) in the pool, which has room here: main RAM is the scarcer (same sound)
REV_POOL=1
PATTERNS=1
# 2026-10-15 (batch 158, the web editor): this profile fills the slot to the byte; the web editor's FX-slot, favorites, oscilloscope and song-chain commands are OFF here so it links
ED_FXP=0
ED_FAVS=0
ED_SCOPE=0
ED_SONG=0
